entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State.
Let the defect(s), if any, be removed within a period of four weeks from today.

The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Sirdala P.S. Case No. 255 of 2021 registered for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 376, 504, 506, 379, 354 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for short 'I.P.C.').
The accused/petitioner is named in the F.I.R. and is in custody since 18.07.2022.

The allegation against the petitioner is to assault informant and also to take Rs. 2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh) in Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64417 of 2022(2) dt.21-02-2023 cash and golden jeweleries on pretext of providing a job, where subsequently the allegation of rape was also added to F.I.R.

entities.text: Taukir Khan @ Taukir Alam vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submitted that from the allegation, as set out through the written complaint of the informant, no allegation of rape/sexual assault was raised against this petitioner, subsequently, by way of improvement, the allegation of rape was raised by victim/informant while recording her statement under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.
It is also submitted that allegation was raised when marriage could not negotiated between the parties, for certain reasons.
While concluding the argument, it has been submitted that investigation has been completed, for which, charge-sheet has been submitted, as such, there is no chance of tampering with the evidence.
Learned APP for the State opposes the prayer of bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances as mentioned above, as no allegation of rape raised against this petitioner through F.I.R., which appears subsequent development while recording statement of victim/informant under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. coupled with the fact that charge-sheet has already been submitted, let the petitioner,
above named, is directed to be released on bail in connection with Sirdala P.S. Case No. 255 of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64417 of 2022(2) dt.21-02-2023 2021 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-I, Nawada/concerned court, subject to the conditions as mentioned under Section 437 (3) of the Cr.

P.C. 
(Chandra Shekhar Jha, J) pooja/-
